verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so prefix or KV caching for repeated prompts is a fair performance question. The evidence pack never mentions prefix caching, prompt caching or KV-cache reuse. Related items (benchmark command, CPU performance reports, vendored llama.cpp) say nothing about this capability and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can speed up repeated-prompt workloads using prefix caching
